review_dimensions.evidence: V3 reproduces the callback authority mutation while V4 snapshots request and authority before the callback and uses the frozen snapshot for both local admission and S.2A.
Descriptor-instrumented request and authority proxies each observe exactly one snapshot pass; audit counts are request=1, authority=1, material=1 and reread=0.
Request and authority accessors are rejected from property descriptors without executing their getters.
All caller-controlled request, anchor and material values pass through the V3 bounded iterative canonicalizer; cycles, depth, node, key, array and string limits fail closed with sanitized reasons.
Canonical request, authority and material snapshots are plain data, deeply frozen and separated from caller inputs; callback and post-verification mutation do not change results.
Pre-admission, V3 request construction, digests, S.2A invocation, failure provenance and audit are derived from the verified snapshot; caller request and authority are not reread.
The self-consistent extra completion-field attack remains non-issued before request construction, S.2A calls or downstream digest work.
Every frozen incomplete, conflicting, not_point_in_time_safe and unmappable scenario has request_constructed=false, s2a_called=false and downstream_digest_work=false.
The issued V4 synthetic handoff preserves issued to completed to bindable to ready to captured to joined interoperability.
Failure identities bind taxonomy, snapshot-bundle digest, admission digest and sorted reasons; distinct rejected snapshots produce distinct identities.
The canonical result digest is identical across UTC A/B, Europe/Stockholm, America/New_York and reversed synthetic input order.
V1-V3 and the two published PR #71 commits are not modified by this additive preservation-tree review.
Normalized 303-artifact and replay 84-artifact roots retain their manifests, digests, 0700/0600 permissions and zero symlinks; no real outcome source was accessed.
